items.name: gSHAPE
items.subtitle: Soil Health Assessment Protocol and Evaluation
items.what: A free web app that scores soil health indicators against benchmarks for your region, instead of one fixed threshold for everyone.
items.why: The same soil carbon value can be excellent in one climate and poor in another. gSHAPE puts each measurement in context so the score is fair and useful for management.
how: Open the app and choose your region and framework.
Select the physical, chemical, and biological indicators you measured.
Enter your values or upload a file.
Read the scores and download the results.
items.note: The app runs on Streamlit. If it has been idle it may take a few seconds to wake up.

items.name: Ethiopia soil organic carbon map
items.subtitle: 250 m national map with uncertainty
items.what: An interactive map of predicted soil organic carbon across Ethiopia, with uncertainty and an area-of-applicability layer.
items.why: Planners and researchers need to see where predictions are reliable, not only what they are.
how: Zoom and pan to any area.
Switch between the prediction, uncertainty, and applicability layers.
Click a location to see its values.
items.note: This viewer is a placeholder. The map will be published here alongside the paper.
